bootstrap.unit: whole trajectory across all sizes and methods

iteration_zero: Projected candidate initial pilot; independently tuned pilot is a different method.
metric: Population noise-free target prediction risk; no observation-noise variance added.
pairing: The same trajectory uses nested data prefixes at every n0 and the same data for all methods.
tuning: 52 method-by-n0 candidates selected using 500 independent development datasets each, frozen before these data.
